body: [{"streamId":"01a1d517-682e-73a6-8abc-3fe9ddde9136","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1d517-682e-73a6-8abc-3fe9ddde9136\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022A draft authored by h9k learn distill states how the platform really treats citations, held-out lessons and retirement, and requires a per-lesson account a reviewer can check, so its challenge stops finding the same template defects each time\u0022},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022The criteria \\u0060h9k learn distill\\u0060 authors say that a plain \\u0060h9k learn\\u0060 with no \\u0060--distilled-from\\u0060 is recorded without refusal, so citing every source is the session\\u0027s own discipline, and no sentence in \\u0060.claude/templates/learn-distill/task.md\\u0060 says the platform prevents a merge from being recorded without its citations.\u0022,\u0022The authored criteria and exit criterion define the inventory as the active list read at session start with \\u0060h9k learn list --project \\u003Cproject\\u003E --limit 500\\u0060 for a project scope, or \\u0060h9k learn list --owner --limit 500\\u0060 for the owner scope, and require the findings document\\u0027s \\u0022What was observed\\u0022 section to name every lesson in that inventory by id under exactly one of six headings: merged into \\u003Cnew id\\u003E; absorbed into existing \\u003Cid\\u003E; retired as wrong or obsolete, with its reason; left alone; held out; not reached.\u0022,\u0022The authored exit criterion requires that per-lesson account even when no merge was warranted, and no longer offers \\u0022it says no merge was warranted\\u0022 as an alternative to it.\u0022,\u0022The authored text treats a lesson as held out (read-only, cited in no merge, named in the findings) exactly when \\u0060h9k learn show\\u0060 prints \\u0022In prompts no\\u0022 for it, and says that a lesson recorded on another node of the owner\\u0027s own fleet for which it prints \\u0022In prompts yes\\u0022 is an ordinary lesson for the task.\u0022,\u0022The authored criteria allow a lesson to be retired into an existing live lesson that already states its whole claim, with no new lesson recorded, and allow a lesson to be retired as wrong or obsolete only when its retirement reason names evidence at the checkout\\u0027s commit: a file and line, or the absence of a named file or symbol.\u0022,\u0022The authored criteria state that every claim in a merged lesson appears in at least one lesson it cites, and that a merge longer than its sources together is not recorded, because a recorded merge becomes the newest lesson and displaces recent ones from the injected prompt section.\u0022,\u0022Every \\u0060h9k learn\\u0060 record command shown in the authored criteria carries \\u0060--task\\u0060 with the authored task\\u0027s own id, as the command in the authored context already does.\u0022,\u0022The sentence in the rendered \\u0060lessons.md\\u0060 that says which lessons are held out of prompts says that a lesson recorded on another node of the owner\\u0027s own fleet reaches prompts, and names the held-out kinds: replicated from a node outside the owner\\u0027s fleet (or when the fleet cannot be read), recorded on a node nobody recorded, and recorded with no provenance. A test over \\u0060LessonsDocumentRenderer.Render\\u0060 asserts the fleet clause.\u0022,\u0022\\u0060docs/scope.md\\u0060 and \\u0060docs/cli.md\\u0060 no longer describe the citation as enforced for every merge: each says the decider refuses a distilled lesson whose citations resolve to nothing, repeat, or name the lesson itself, and that a plain \\u0060h9k learn\\u0060 with no \\u0060--distilled-from\\u0060 is recorded without any.\u0022,\u0022\\u0060LearningDistillTests\\u0060 asserts, over the task \\u0060LearningDistillCommand.Author\\u0060 produces for both a project scope and the owner scope, that the six headings and that scope\\u0027s \\u0060--limit 500\\u0060 inventory command appear in the criteria and the exit criterion, and that the authored text no longer contains \\u0022no way to record a merge without the citations\\u0022 or \\u0022or it says no merge was warranted\\u0022; its existing assertions on the old wording are updated to the new wording, and the class passes.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022## Where the replacement text comes from\\n\\nThe challenge of the earlier distillation draft 9c5caf8c found these defects in the shipped template, not in that draft; the distillation before it (0fe36d3d) carried the same defects and was fixed by hand. The report is \\u0060/Users/brianhallmanac/.hall9k/runs/01a1d1f9-680f-7475-b4ed-e35643a92bef/challenge-report.md\\u0060. Its section \\u0022Proposed criteria, if a person republishes this once new lessons have accrued\\u0022 holds eight criteria and an exit criterion; use them as the replacement for the five \\u0060criterion-*\\u0060 keys and the \\u0060exit-criterion\\u0060 key in \\u0060.claude/templates/learn-distill/task.md\\u0060, with two substitutions: \\u0060\\u003Cthis task\\u0027s id\\u003E\\u0060 becomes \\u0060{{TaskId}}\\u0060, and \\u0060--project hall9k\\u0060 becomes \\u0060{{ListArguments}}\\u0060. The same report\\u0027s \\u0022False or misleading\\u0022 items 1 and 2 give the evidence for the citation and held-out corrections. The context key\\u0027s held-out paragraph and its \\u0022or the section says no merge was warranted\\u0022 clause need the same corrections as the criteria.\\n\\n## The code change the template needs\\n\\nToday only the \\u0060objective\\u0060 and \\u0060context\\u0060 keys receive substitutions. \\u0060LearningDistillCommand.Criteria()\\u0060 and \\u0060ExitCriterion()\\u0060 load their keys with no values (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Cli/Commands/LearningDistillCommand.cs:181,194-201\\u0060), so a \\u0060{{TaskId}}\\u0060 or \\u0060{{ListArguments}}\\u0060 placed in a criterion would reach the draft unreplaced. Both need the task id and the list arguments (built at \\u0060LearningDistillCommand.cs:217\\u0060) passed in from \\u0060Author\\u0060 (\\u0060:158-178\\u0060), and \\u0060Criteria()\\u0060 needs the new keys listed. The tests call \\u0060Criteria()\\u0060 directly (\\u0060tests/Hall9k.Tests/Cli/LearningDistillTests.cs:45,82,125\\u0060) and will need the new signature.\\n\\n## Facts the corrections rest on, at commit fa6b3970c\\n\\n- A call with no \\u0060--distilled-from\\u0060 goes to \\u0060LearningDecider.Record\\u0060, not \\u0060RecordDistilled\\u0060, so the empty-citation refusal never fires from the CLI (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Cli/Commands/LearnCommand.cs:123-127\\u0060; \\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Learning/LearningDecider.cs:52-58,61-80\\u0060).\\n- \\u0060AgentOnFleetNode\\u0060 reaches prompts (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Learning/LessonProvenanceMark.cs:63,146\\u0060). \\u0060AgentOnAnotherNode\\u0060 (outside the fleet or fleet unknown), \\u0060AgentOnUnobservedNode\\u0060, \\u0060ReplicatedFromOutsideFleet\\u0060 and \\u0060Unknown\\u0060 are held (\\u0060:73,82,93,97\\u0060), and \\u0060HeldFromPrompts\\u0060 (\\u0060:111-112\\u0060) lists them with their labels.\\n- \\u0060h9k learn show\\u0060 prints the \\u0022In prompts\\u0022 yes or no line (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Cli/Commands/LearningShowCommand.cs:144-150\\u0060).\\n- \\u0060h9k learn list\\u0060 shows 20 by default (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Cli/Commands/LearningListCommand.cs:23,69\\u0060).\\n- The injected section is newest first and ends at the first lesson that does not fit (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Learning/InjectedLessons.cs:243-253\\u0060).\\n- The renderer\\u0027s held-out sentence is \\u0060src/Hall9k.Domain/Features/Learning/LessonsDocumentRenderer.cs:63-69\\u0060. \\u0060docs/concepts.md:115-121\\u0060 already describes the fleet rule correctly and can serve as wording.\\n- The doc sentences calling the citation enforced are \\u0060docs/scope.md:613-615\\u0060 and \\u0060docs/cli.md:195-199\\u0060.\\n- The assertions on the old wording are \\u0060LearningDistillTests.cs:50,52,55-58,179-180\\u0060. No prompt golden carries this template\\u0027s text.\\n\\n## Why the type is Bugfix and not Content\\n\\nThe template tells sessions false things about the platform, and the fix touches compiled code and tests. A Content task fails before its gates when its diff touches any path outside the project\\u0027s non-executable set, which here is \\u0060*.md\\u0060, \\u0060docs/\\u0060, \\u0060.claude/skills/\\u0060 and \\u0060assets/**\\u0060 (\\u0060src/Hall9k.Daemon/Execution/VerificationRunner.cs:319-333\\u0060). A template-only change would instead skip the gates entirely (\\u0060:293-303\\u0060) while the existing assertions above fail on main.\\n\\n## Out of scope\\n\\nLesson caps, the picker, and scoping a distillation to lessons recorded since the last one (a separate idea if wanted). The 500 limit is a fixed bound for the inventory read; it is not a new
